summary: Iteration 9 SAWALI — Form Analytics Dashboard (global + per-form + CSV). BACKEND: 12/13 pytest pass (3.3s) against https://sawali-portal.preview.emergentagent.com. Verified: shape of /api/me/forms-analytics (scope=global, total_forms, total_views, public_count, private_count, submissions{total/auth_count/anon_count/series/top_authors/by_country}, top_forms); per-form /api/me/forms/{id}/analytics (scope=form, form meta, views, submissions, completion_rate, auth_count, anon_count, series, by_country, top_authors, recent[<=10]); CSV export returns UTF-8 BOM (b'\xef\xbb\xbf'), correct Content-Disposition (attachment; filename=FORM-<code>-<n>-submissions.csv), header [id,date,auteur,type,email,pays,ville,ip,<field labels>]; one row per submission; non-owner→403 for both detail + csv; 404 for unknown form_id on both; anonymous public submission with geo.country='France' correctly increments anon_count, appears in by_country as 'France', and appears in today's series datapoint; authenticated submission populates top_authors without exposing anon labels; global scope is properly client-scoped (secondary client with no forms → total_forms=0 / top_forms=[] / 0 submissions). FRONTEND: Admin login (OTP dev flow) + JWT in localStorage('sawali_token','sawali_user') works. /portal/forms shows the 'Analytics global' button (data-testid=forms-global-analytics-btn) which navigates to /portal/forms/analytics. The global page renders analytics-timeseries, analytics-pie and analytics-top-forms; 7j/30j/90j/1an quick buttons all trigger re-fetch without error. /portal/forms/{fid}/analytics renders form-analytics-detail-page including KPIs and the analytics-export-csv-btn; clicking the button triggers an actual file download (page.expect_download) yielding FORM-SAWALISM-0004-submissions.csv with UTF-8 BOM. ONE BACKEND BUG FOUND: date_from / date_to filters produce empty result because _now() returns ISO STRING while _submissions_analytics passes datetime objects to Mongo — BSON type ordering (String=2 vs Date=9) means `created_at >= <datetime>` never matches string-typed docs. The test test_date_range_today_includes_seed exposes it (0 submissions returned for [today, tomorrow] range though 2 submissions exist). The other date tests pass incidentally because they expected empty results for future-date ranges (empty from either bug or correctness). ONE FRONTEND UX BUG: the admin user NEVER sees per-card 'Stats' buttons on /portal/forms — FormsList server logic sets client_scope=None for admin, so is_mine is always false for admin; only real clients see form-analytics-<id> buttons on their own cards. Workaround exists (Analytics global → top-forms or direct URL).

critical.issue: date_from / date_to filters are broken. _now() in /app/backend/models.py returns an ISO-format string (datetime.now(tz).isoformat()) so form_submissions.created_at is stored as a string in Mongo. _submissions_analytics builds `{'created_at': {'$gte': <datetime>, '$lte': <datetime>}}` → BSON compares type first (String=2 < Date=9) and the query returns ZERO docs for any real date window. Reproducer: POST two public submissions today, then GET /api/me/forms/{id}/analytics?date_from=<today>&date_to=<tomorrow> → submissions=0 instead of >=2. Fix options: (a) convert date_from/date_to to ISO strings before $gte/$lte (`df.isoformat()` / `dt.isoformat()`); OR (b) change _now() to return a datetime object and migrate existing docs; (a) is least invasive and keeps backwards compat.

ui_bugs.issue: Admin never sees 'Stats' buttons. me_list_forms sets client_scope=None when user.role==admin, so `it['is_mine'] = it.get('client_id') == None` is always false → the is_mine guard in FormsList.jsx hides Éditer/Stats/Partager/Delete for admin on every card. Admin can still use /portal/forms/analytics→top-forms or direct URL /portal/forms/<id>/analytics. Suggested fix: in me_list_forms, for admin use `is_mine = True` (or compute it as `f.created_by_id == user.id`) so admin has per-card actions.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py _submissions_analytics: the $match spreads `match` first then overrides created_at — a caller passing its own created_at in match (like per_form_match at L4790-4795) is re-set, OK here but keep in mind for future callers.

server.py me_form_analytics_detail.completion_rate computes submissions/views*100 with views=uses_count. But uses_count is incremented in /api/me/forms/{id}/submission and /api/public/forms/{id}/submission — it tracks SUBMISSIONS, not page views. So 'completion_rate' semantically equals ~100% whenever there are submissions. Consider tracking views separately (e.g., new endpoint POST /api/public/forms/{id}/view) or renaming the KPI to 'Taux d'utilisation'.

server.py _require_owner_or_admin uses `(user.client_id or user.id)` — if a tracked-user (sub-user) has client_id set correctly, OK; but if client_id is missing for any reason the check degrades to comparing form.client_id to user.id which could be wrong. Add defensive logging when client_id is missing.

FormAnalyticsDetail.jsx: CSV export does `fetch(..., { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('sawali_token')}` } })` — if token is missing/expired the response is a JSON error but the code still .blob()s it and saves a 2-byte file as CSV. Add `if (!res.ok) throw ...` and surface a toast.

FormsAnalytics.jsx: the quick-range buttons (7j/30j/90j/1an) set dates then call load() — but date <input type=date> is still the native browser picker (inconsistent with the rest of the admin UI which uses shadcn). Consistent with earlier review comment iter8.
_analytics_scope_query(user, admin_all=True) always returns {} for admin — no way to switch an admin into 'only-my-forms' view from the UI. Minor; fine for MVP.

rca of the issue: DATE FILTER BUG — RCA: (1) models.py:_now() returns datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() — a STRING. (2) All form_submissions are inserted with `created_at: _now()` (public_submit_form L4662, me_form_submission elsewhere), so the field is BSON type String. (3) server.py:_submissions_analytics (L4696-4702) builds `range_q['$gte'] = date_from` where date_from is a datetime returned by _parse_date. (4) MongoDB compares BSON types before values when running `$gte` across mixed types; String (type 2) is strictly less than Date (type 9), so `<string> >= <Date>` is always false. Net effect: any request with date_from/date_to filters returns an EMPTY result set regardless of actual data. Reproduction: POST /api/public/forms/<fid>/submission then GET /api/me/forms/<fid>/analytics?date_from=<today> → submissions=0 (expected >=1). Mitigation options (pick ONE): (A) Convert date boundaries to ISO strings before mongo: `range_q['$gte'] = date_from.isoformat()`; `range_q['$lte'] = date_to.isoformat()`. Because ISO-8601 Z-format sorts lexicographically == chronologically, string `$gte` works on string-stored timestamps. Apply the same in me_forms_analytics_global (per-form aggregate L4790-4795) and me_form_analytics_csv (match L4888-4893). (B) Change models.py:_now() to return a raw datetime and migrate existing string timestamps to BSON Date via one-shot script — heavier but 'correct' type-wise. Recommend (A) as minimal fix.
